editorial:
Imagine being a cop who thinks he is untouchable because he has spent years breaking the rules and covering up his tracks. That is exactly where you find Raman. He is a tough guy with a dark past full of fake police encounters, but his luck finally runs out when he meets Ajooni. She is not intimidated by him at all and spends the whole movie putting him in a tight spot. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel like you are right there in the middle of a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where the roles keep switching.

The acting is top-notch, and the way the tension builds up keeps you glued to your seat. While some parts of the story move a bit slow in the middle, the big twists make it totally worth it. If you love stories about corrupt cops getting what they deserve, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, it turns out Ajooni was not just a random challenger but a former victim of Raman's past crimes. She records him confessing to all his fake encounters during a final confrontation. Instead of killing him, she hands the evidence to the internal affairs department. Raman ends up in a prison cell, realizing that his own greed and power played a trick on him. Justice finally wins as he loses everything.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty police dramas and revenge stories.
